name: Oracle
summary: The release gives no specific capital-expenditure figure for future periods; it says FY2026 free cash flow was negative $23.7 billion as Oracle kept investing in Cloud Infrastructure, that prepaid and customer-supplied GPU hardware in large AI contracts now totals $75 billion and substantially reduces the capital Oracle must raise, and that Oracle expects to raise approximately $40 billion in debt and equity financing in fiscal year 2027 to fund its capital investment program, driven by growing demand for AI training and inferencing infrastructure.
